entries.03fafe994f2c938c: Individuals who make support purchases (project supporters)
entries.06d5e3e27018764b: A company that operates "Makuake," a venue for advance sales of new products and services, providing a support-purchase service that connects businesses and consumers.
entries.3c0f4bc9996b7f1e: An incubation service that supports the creation of new businesses by making use of research and development technologies and proprietary technologies held by companies and other organizations. Drawing on customer needs data and know-how accumulated through operating Makuake, it supports product development and receives fees. Sales for the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥78 million.
entries.441d46bb3b7f7101: A single segment of the support purchase service that connects, over the internet, businesses that offer new products and services not yet available anywhere (project executors) with consumers who purchase with a supportive sentiment after understanding the creators’ thoughts and background (project supporters). Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥4,577 million.
entries.44fc1d9911139cab: Businesses that sell new products and services in advance (project executors)
entries.ace7042ef14ada5f: A group of services related to the operation of Makuake. They include advertising distribution services for project executors; the Anshin System usage program, which provides a place where supporters can make support purchases with peace of mind; Makuake STORE, which relays sales of products after projects end through various EC sites; Makuake SHOP, which displays and sells Makuake-originated products at physical stores of partner companies nationwide; and Makuake Insight, which supports product development and promotion strategy design using purchasing behavior data and consumer surveys. Sales for the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥1,197 million.
entries.f55b4fe46101d5eb: A support purchase service for new things and experiences. Under this mechanism, businesses sell new products and services before mass production, and supporters make advance purchases (support purchases); when a project succeeds, the company receives a support fee from the project executor and a system usage fee from supporters, which is used for maintaining the site environment and similar purposes. There are the All-in method, under which sales proceeds are provided to the executor regardless of whether the target is reached, and the All or Nothing method, under which they are provided only when the target amount is reached. Sales for the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥3,301 million.
